entries.value: Every flame in the area turns green and points toward the same distant ruin for one minute.
A terrified courier mistakes a party member for their contact and hands over a sealed royal confession.
A localized rainstorm follows one character while the sky remains clear everywhere else.
Two merchants begin an escalating auction for an ordinary item carried by the party, refusing to explain why.
A wounded monster crashes into the scene, fleeing from something far more dangerous just out of sight.
All spoken lies become visible as black smoke until sunset, causing immediate panic in the nearest settlement.
A festival starts unexpectedly; its central competition recreates a recent party achievement with wildly incorrect details.
An earthquake opens a stairway beneath the road and seals the path ahead.
A child calmly asks the party to remove the ghost living under their bed; the ghost claims the child is the haunting.
A shower of tiny harmless frogs falls from a cloudless sky, each bearing the same golden rune.
The party encounters their own wanted posters, issued tomorrow and accusing them of a crime that has not happened yet.
A nearby statue turns its head and whispers a warning to the character with the lowest perception.
A caravan offers safe passage, but every traveler insists they have always known one of the heroes.
For one hour, shadows detach from their owners and act out their owners' hidden intentions.
A bridge collapses after the party crosses, separating them from pursuing enemies and their easiest route home.
A magical market appears between two trees and will vanish after exactly thirteen purchases.
A dying raven delivers a signet ring and repeats a place name no map records.
An eclipse begins years ahead of schedule; magical powers behave in reversed or symbolic ways.
A noble procession blocks the road while masked rebels prepare an ambush from both sides.
The nearest river runs backward, exposing a wreck full of sealed cargo and awakening its drowned crew.
A famous adventurer publicly credits the party for a deed they did not do and asks them to maintain the story.
Everyone in a village has fallen asleep except one deeply suspicious baker.
A wandering judge declares an improvised trial over ownership of a talking sword that chose a party member.
A harmless animal begins speaking with the voice of an absent ally and asks for urgent help.
The moon briefly shows a second face, after which every compass points toward the party.
A battlefield from the distant past overlays the present landscape, and ghostly actions cause real damage.
A thief steals something trivial but leaves behind an item far more valuable and dangerously recognizable.
A bell rings underground; local elders insist there is no bell and order everyone indoors.
A spontaneous peace negotiation begins between two hostile factions, and both choose the party as neutral witnesses.
Time skips forward three hours for everyone except the party, who are now blamed for what happened during the gap.
